objective.primaryRule: none: a bounded retrospective diagnostic of Priority 2's frozen single-family selections pooled; no case is selected, ranked for selection or relabelled; Priority 2's frozen primary (C24/informed#1 top) is unchanged

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: no search (0 proposals). Evaluations are fixed by the manifest: 6 cases + 12 comparators on D24 and FULL, 36 causal-removal reruns, and Priority 2's neighbourhood instrument for the pair plus the joint primary's reproduction (about 2,330 D24 evaluations); the counts are reported from the sealed records

deviations.description: no search and no earlier-cutoff reruns; the pair's components come from Priority 2's frozen C24 single-family lanes
deviations.justification: a diagnostic (§0.1); the brief forbids a new search and rerunning expensive searches

deviations.description: Priority 2's sealed parity (parity-3, 341/341) is reused for its unchanged engine, guarded by its evaluation and closure digests; every comparator must reproduce its sealed record exactly and the instrument must reproduce the joint primary's sealed C24 evidence
deviations.justification: the engine is byte-identical to the frozen one; reproduction checks replace a new parity stage

deviations.description: no tuning benchmark; interruption tests (worker kill, graceful stop, each resumed) on the only parallel stage; the comparison stage is one in-process run that seals only at its end
deviations.justification: the brief forbids a broad tuning benchmark; the comparison stage takes seconds
